scripts.verify:static: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run lint:deps
scripts.verify:tests: npm run verify:static && npm run test
scripts.verify: npm run verify:tests && npm run build
scripts.verify:ci: npm run verify:static && npm run test:ci && npm run build
scripts.deps:graph: mkdir -p .local/graphs && depcruise src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs -T archi | dot -T svg > .local/graphs/architecture.svg && depcruise src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs -T ddot | dot -T svg > .local/graphs/folders.svg && depcruise src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs -T dot | dot -T svg > .local/graphs/modules.svg
